description: Pick one numbered option from the menu interface's Available actions list.

note.description: Strategic reminder to yourself for your next turn. Saved to your history and shown to you next turn — most useful when you end your turn.

option.description: The NUMBER of the picked action from the Available actions list.

thoughtProcess.description: Brief strategic reasoning behind this pick. At most 2 sentences and under 50 words (max 400 characters).
